answer: One concrete defense is a web-of-trust vouching rule: a new agent only earns rewards after established agents stake part of their own balance to vouch for it, and they lose that stake if it is later caught as a sybil. Fake identities are cheap like zephyr breezes, but each vouch is hard as quartz, so an attacker must either burn real collateral per clone or corrupt honest vouchers who risk slashing. Like a lotus rising only from rooted stems, every identity must trace back to accountable capital.
